claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two direct Referee component helpers exposed by FACT-0067 are exact method bodies. Referee.Init (0x06005079) has an exact 167-byte body with parameters costume and fsize. It constructs a new FormRenderer with raw arguments (null, this.gameObject), stores it in Referee.FormRen, stores fsize in both Referee.formSize and FormRenderer.formSize, then loops raw index 0 through 8. Each iteration copies costume.partsScale[index] into FormRen.partsScale[index]; after the copy, the emitted bge.un comparison against raw 0.0f skips replacement for values that are greater/equal or unordered, while an ordered-negative value is replaced with raw 1.0f. The method then writes Referee.PlPos Vector3 components x=0.0f, y=0.0f, z=1.0f and returns. Referee.ReqRefereeAnm (0x06005096) has an exact 92-byte branchless body with one parameter an: it stores SkillID=an, FrameWait=0, isCount29=0, reqAnmInit=1, and raw zero into isReqAnmLoopEnd, isAnmLooped, isAnmPause, isAnmSync, isCopiedOpponentDir, isAnmBoot, isAtkHitOff, isAttackHit and isAttackHit2, then returns. FACT-0067 pins the two MatchMain and two MatchMainCp caller sites for these helpers.
